Infrastruttura immutabile

A design principle in which infrastructure components are never modified after deployment; updates are implemented by replacing rather than changing resources.

Definition

A design principle in which infrastructure components are never modified after deployment; updates are implemented by replacing rather than changing resources.

Operational example

Immutable infrastructure ensures consistency by enforcing that updates require redeployment of new resources instead of modifying existing ones.

Localized term

Localized example
